verdict.rationale: Cline has the building blocks for automated review but no turnkey per-PR reviewer. It runs headlessly inside GitHub Actions, GitLab and other CI pipelines, it can review piped diffs (`git diff | cline "review these changes"`), and it can run scheduled code reviews on cron. The developer still has to wire these into their own pipeline. missing for 10: a native PR review integration that triggers automatically on every pull request, inline PR comments posted back to GitHub/GitLab, documented setup for PR review workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
